transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
Hello, doctor. I'm here because I've been feeling persistently depressed and sad for about a year and ten months now. It feels like a constant low mood that I just can't seem to shake.
Did these depressed feelings start after a specific stressful life event or major change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?

I honestly can't recall any specific stressful event or clear trigger that started this. These feelings just seemed to develop gradually on their own around a year and ten months ago. There wasn't one particular thing that happened to cause it.
During these past 1 year and 10 months, have there been any stretches of 2 months or longer when you felt mostly back to normal, or has the low mood been there nearly all the time?

No, there haven't been any breaks like that at all. The sadness and low mood have been there nearly all the time without any periods of feeling back to normal. It has just been a constant, heavy feeling for the entire year and ten months.

During this time, have there been periods lasting at least 2 weeks when your depression got noticeably worse and you also had several other symptoms like loss of interest, sleep or appetite changes, low energy, poor concentration, guilt, or thoughts of death?

Yes, I have definitely experienced those worse periods, particularly with my sleep being completely disrupted and feeling a deep sense of emptiness. It feels like that severe state has been constant rather than just coming and going.
Before this severe state became constant, was there ever a period of at least 2 years of milder but ongoing depression, or did the severe symptoms start within the first 2 years?
No, there wasn't any period of milder depression before this. My entire struggle has only lasted for about a year and ten months in total, so everything started within this timeframe.
During this depression, have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
I haven't really noticed a loss of interest in my usual activities, or at least I'm not quite sure. Mostly, it just feels like my emotions are completely numb and I'm constantly sad.
Besides feeling sad, have you had low energy, poor concentration, changes in appetite, feelings of worthlessness or guilt, or thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
No, I haven't really experienced any of those symptoms. My energy, concentration, and appetite have been mostly normal, and I don't have feelings of guilt or thoughts of ending my life.
To make sure I understand, has this depressed mood lasted for less than 2 years total, or has it reached 2 years or more?
It has been about 1 year and 10 months, so it is slightly less than 2 years total. It hasn't quite reached the 2-year mark yet.
When you say your sleep has been completely disrupted, are you having trouble falling asleep, waking up often, or sleeping much more than usual?

Yes, I actually experience a mix of all of those; I struggle to fall asleep initially, wake up frequently throughout the night, and often wake up too early. There are also times when I sleep for excessively long periods, but I always wake up feeling completely unrefreshed, often due to vivid nightmares.
Have you gone through a traumatic event that keeps coming back in nightmares or unwanted memories, and do you avoid reminders of it?

I don't think I've ever experienced a traumatic event like that, and I don't really avoid any reminders. However, I definitely do suffer from frequent, distressing nightmares that constantly disrupt my sleep.
